All Z are Y.

Some Y are B.

I. Some B are not Z.

II. Some Y are not Z.

III. Some Z are Y.
options_en: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

II. Some Y are not Z is FALSE as there are not any negative statements. So, possibility is always there.

III. Some Z are Y is TRUE as all Z are Y.

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

'P $ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

'P % Q' means 'P is the daughter-in-law of Q'.

'P @ Q' means 'P is the uncle of Q'.

questions.solution_en:
It is given that:

P & Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

'P $ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

'P % Q' means 'P is the daughter-in-law of Q'.

'P @ Q' means 'P is the uncle of Q'.

S is the daughter-in-law of D.

D is the daughter of F.

F is the father of G.

G is the uncle of H.

G is unmarried.

Thus, S is the wife of H.

questions.q_en: If 14 January 2022 was Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 28 February 2025?
questions.solution_en:
The number of days between 14 January 2022 and 14 January 2025

= 365 + 365 + 366 (as 2024 is a leap year) = 1096.

The number of days between 14 January 2025 and 28 February 2025 = 17 (in January) + 28 (in February) = 45.

Total number of days = 1096 + 45 = 1141.

Each day is repeated after 7 days.

1141/7 = 163.

Hence, it will be a Friday on 28 February 2025 which is exactly 163 weeks after 14 January 2022.
